def rmse(y_true, y_pred):
    return np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred))

def evaluate_model(model, X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y_va, X_te, y_te, name):
    pred_tr = model.predict(X_tr)
    pred_va = model.predict(X_va)
    pred_te = model.predict(X_te)
    return {
        'Model': name,
        'Train R2': r2_score(y_tr, pred_tr),
        'Val R2': r2_score(y_va, pred_va),
        'Test R2': r2_score(y_te, pred_te),
        'Train RMSE': rmse(y_tr, pred_tr),
        'Val RMSE': rmse(y_va, pred_va),
        'Test RMSE': rmse(y_te, pred_te),
        'Train MAE': mean_absolute_error(y_tr, pred_tr),
        'Val MAE': mean_absolute_error(y_va, pred_va),
        'Test MAE': mean_absolute_error(y_te, pred_te)
    }

def objective_rf(trial):
    params = {
        'n_estimators': trial.suggest_int('n_estimators', 100, 500),
        'max_depth': trial.suggest_int('max_depth', 3, 6),          # shallow
        'min_samples_split': trial.suggest_int('min_samples_split', 10, 50),
        'min_samples_leaf': trial.suggest_int('min_samples_leaf', 5, 30),
        'max_features': trial.suggest_categorical('max_features', ['sqrt', 'log2']),
        'random_state': 42
    }
    scores = []
    for tr_idx, va_idx in tscv.split(X_train):
        X_tr, X_va = X_train[tr_idx], X_train[va_idx]
        y_tr, y_va = y_train.iloc[tr_idx], y_train.iloc[va_idx]
        model = RandomForestRegressor(**params, n_jobs=-1)
        model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
        pred = model.predict(X_va)
        scores.append(rmse(y_va, pred))
    return np.mean(scores)

study_rf = optuna.create_study(direction='minimize', sampler=TPESampler(seed=42))
study_rf.optimize(objective_rf, n_trials=10, show_progress_bar=True)
best_rf = RandomForestRegressor(**study_rf.best_params, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
best_rf.fit(X_train, y_train)
print("Best RF params:", study_rf.best_params)

def objective_lgb_linear(trial):
    params = {
        'boosting_type': 'gbdt',
        'linear_tree': True,
        'n_estimators': trial.suggest_int('n_estimators', 500, 1000),
        'max_depth': trial.suggest_int('max_depth', 2, 4),
        'learning_rate': trial.suggest_float('learning_rate', 0.005, 0.02, log=True),
        'subsample': trial.suggest_float('subsample', 0.5, 0.8),
        'colsample_bytree': trial.suggest_float('colsample_bytree', 0.5, 0.8),
        'min_child_samples': trial.suggest_int('min_child_samples', 50, 200),
        'reg_alpha': trial.suggest_float('reg_alpha', 1.0, 20.0, log=True),
        'reg_lambda': trial.suggest_float('reg_lambda', 1.0, 20.0, log=True),
        'random_state': 42,
        'verbosity': -1
    }
    scores = []
    for tr_idx, va_idx in tscv.split(X_train):
        X_tr, X_va = X_train[tr_idx], X_train[va_idx]
        y_tr, y_va = y_train.iloc[tr_idx], y_train.iloc[va_idx]
        model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**params)
        model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=[(X_va, y_va)], eval_metric='rmse',
                  callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(20, verbose=False)])
        pred = model.predict(X_va)
        scores.append(rmse(y_va, pred))
    return np.mean(scores)

study_lgb_lin = optuna.create_study(direction='minimize', sampler=TPESampler(seed=42))
study_lgb_lin.optimize(objective_lgb_linear, n_trials=10, show_progress_bar=True)
best_lgb_lin = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**study_lgb_lin.best_params, random_state=42)
# Final training on full training data (no validation set used for early stopping here)
best_lgb_lin.fit(X_train, y_train)
print("Best LightGBM (linear) params:", study_lgb_lin.best_params)

def objective_mlp(trial):
    hidden_layer_sizes = trial.suggest_categorical('hidden_layer_sizes', [(32,), (64,), (32,16), (64,32)])
    activation = trial.suggest_categorical('activation', ['relu', 'tanh'])
    alpha = trial.suggest_float('alpha', 1e-5, 1e-1, log=True)
    learning_rate_init = trial.suggest_float('learning_rate_init', 1e-4, 1e-2, log=True)

    model = MLPRegressor(
        hidden_layer_sizes=hidden_layer_sizes,
        activation=activation,
        alpha=alpha,
        learning_rate_init=learning_rate_init,
        max_iter=200,
        early_stopping=True,
        validation_fraction=0.1,
        random_state=42
    )

    scores = []
    for tr_idx, va_idx in tscv.split(X_train):
        X_tr, X_va = X_train[tr_idx], X_train[va_idx]
        y_tr, y_va = y_train.iloc[tr_idx], y_train.iloc[va_idx]
        model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
        pred = model.predict(X_va)
        scores.append(rmse(y_va, pred))
    return np.mean(scores)

study_mlp = optuna.create_study(direction='minimize', sampler=TPESampler(seed=42))
study_mlp.optimize(objective_mlp, n_trials=10, show_progress_bar=True)

best_mlp = MLPRegressor(**study_mlp.best_params, max_iter=500, early_stopping=True, random_state=42)
best_mlp.fit(X_train, y_train)

print("Best MLP params:", study_mlp.best_params)

def objective_lgb_quantile(trial):
    params = {
        'objective': 'quantile',

def objective_xgb(trial):
    params = {
        'n_estimators': trial.suggest_int('n_estimators', 500, 1000),
        'max_depth': trial.suggest_int('max_depth', 2, 3),
        'learning_rate': trial.suggest_float('learning_rate', 0.001, 0.01, log=True),
        'subsample': trial.suggest_float('subsample', 0.3, 0.6),
        'colsample_bytree': trial.suggest_float('colsample_bytree', 0.3, 0.6),
        'min_child_weight': trial.suggest_int('min_child_weight', 20, 50),
        'gamma': trial.suggest_float('gamma', 2.0, 10.0),
        'reg_alpha': trial.suggest_float('reg_alpha', 5.0, 50.0, log=True),
        'reg_lambda': trial.suggest_float('reg_lambda', 5.0, 50.0, log=True),
        'random_state': 42,
        'eval_metric': 'rmse',
        'early_stopping_rounds': 20,
        'verbosity': 0
    }
    scores = []
    for tr_idx, va_idx in tscv.split(X_train):
        X_tr, X_va = X_train[tr_idx], X_train[va_idx]
        y_tr, y_va = y_train.iloc[tr_idx], y_train.iloc[va_idx]
        model = xgb.XGBRegressor(**params)
        model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=[(X_va, y_va)], verbose=False)
        pred = model.predict(X_va)
        scores.append(rmse(y_va, pred))
    return np.mean(scores)

study_xgb = optuna.create_study(direction='minimize', sampler=TPESampler(seed=42))
study_xgb.optimize(objective_xgb, n_trials=10, show_progress_bar=True)

# Final training with history capture
# Final training with history capture
best_xgb_params = study_xgb.best_params.copy()
best_xgb_params['early_stopping_rounds'] = 20
best_xgb_params['eval_metric'] = 'rmse'
best_xgb = xgb.XGBRegressor(**best_xgb_params)

# Fit with eval_set to enable early stopping and record history
best_xgb.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], verbose=False)

# Now extract the evaluation history
xgb_history = best_xgb.evals_result()

print("Best XGBoost params:", study_xgb.best_params)

def objective_lgb(trial):
    params = {
        'n_estimators': trial.suggest_int('n_estimators', 500, 1000),
        'max_depth': trial.suggest_int('max_depth', 2, 3),
        'learning_rate': trial.suggest_float('learning_rate', 0.001, 0.01, log=True),
        'subsample': trial.suggest_float('subsample', 0.3, 0.6),
        'colsample_bytree': trial.suggest_float('colsample_bytree', 0.3, 0.6),
        'min_child_samples': trial.suggest_int('min_child_samples', 100, 300),
        'reg_alpha': trial.suggest_float('reg_alpha', 5.0, 50.0, log=True),
        'reg_lambda': trial.suggest_float('reg_lambda', 5.0, 50.0, log=True),
        'random_state': 42,
        'verbosity': -1
    }
    scores = []
    for tr_idx, va_idx in tscv.split(X_train):
        X_tr, X_va = X_train[tr_idx], X_train[va_idx]
        y_tr, y_va = y_train.iloc[tr_idx], y_train.iloc[va_idx]
        model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**params)
        model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=[(X_va, y_va)], eval_metric='rmse',
                  callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(20, verbose=False)])
        pred = model.predict(X_va)
        scores.append(rmse(y_va, pred))
    return np.mean(scores)

def objective_cat(trial):
    params = {
        'iterations': trial.suggest_int('iterations', 500, 1000),
        'depth': trial.suggest_int('depth', 2, 3),
        'learning_rate': trial.suggest_float('learning_rate', 0.001, 0.01, log=True),
        'l2_leaf_reg': trial.suggest_float('l2_leaf_reg', 10, 50),
        'border_count': trial.suggest_int('border_count', 32, 64),
        'random_seed': 42,
        'verbose': False
    }
    scores = []
    for tr_idx, va_idx in tscv.split(X_train):
        X_tr, X_va = X_train[tr_idx], X_train[va_idx]
        y_tr, y_va = y_train.iloc[tr_idx], y_train.iloc[va_idx]
        model = CatBoostRegressor(**params)
        model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=(X_va, y_va), early_stopping_rounds=20, verbose=False)
        pred = model.predict(X_va)
        scores.append(rmse(y_va, pred))
    return np.mean(scores)

lookback = 4   # same as in feature engineering

def create_sequences(X, y, lookback):
    Xs, ys = [], []
    for i in range(len(X) - lookback):
        Xs.append(X[i:i+lookback])
        ys.append(y[i+lookback])
    return np.array(Xs), np.array(ys)

X_tr_seq, y_tr_seq = create_sequences(X_train, y_train.values, lookback)
X_val_seq, y_val_seq = create_sequences(X_val, y_val.values, lookback)
X_test_seq, y_test_seq = create_sequences(X_test, y_test.values, lookback)
In [17]:
def objective_lstm(trial):
    units = trial.suggest_categorical('units', [16, 32])
    dropout = trial.suggest_categorical('dropout', [0.3, 0.4])
    lr = trial.suggest_categorical('lr', [1e-4, 5e-4])
    batch_size = 32
    model = Sequential([
        LSTM(units, activation='tanh', input_shape=(lookback, X_train.shape[1])),
        Dropout(dropout),
        Dense(8, activation='relu'),
        Dense(1)
    ])
    model.compile(optimizer=Adam(learning_rate=lr), loss='mse')
    early_stop = EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=5, restore_best_weights=True)
    history = model.fit(X_tr_seq, y_tr_seq, validation_data=(X_val_seq, y_val_seq),
                        epochs=30, batch_size=batch_size, callbacks=[early_stop], verbose=0)
    val_pred = model.predict(X_val_seq, verbose=0).flatten()
    return rmse(y_val_seq, val_pred)

study_lstm = optuna.create_study(direction='minimize', sampler=TPESampler(seed=42))
study_lstm.optimize(objective_lstm, n_trials=5, show_progress_bar=True)

def judge(row):
    gap = row['Train R2'] - row['Test R2']
    if row['Test R2'] < 0:
        return "Test R2 negative – severe concept drift"
    if gap < 0.1:
        return "Excellent – very low overfitting"
    elif gap < 0.2:
        return "Good – mild overfitting"
    elif gap < 0.3:
        return "Moderate overfitting – acceptable"
    else:
        return "Severe overfitting – needs more regularisation"

results_df['Train-Test R2 Gap'] = results_df['Train R2'] - results_df['Test R2']
results_df['Judgment'] = results_df.apply(judge, axis=1)
results_df[['Model', 'Train R2', 'Test R2', 'Train-Test R2 Gap', 'Judgment']]

def plot_model_diagnostics(name, preds, actual_full, actual_test, history=None):
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 10))
    fig.suptitle(f'{name} – Diagnostic Plots (Tuned)', fontsize=16)

    # 1. Full dataset time series
    ax = axes[0, 0]
    time_full = np.arange(len(actual_full))
    ax.plot(time_full, actual_full, label='Actual', alpha=0.7)
    ax.plot(time_full, preds['full'], label='Predicted', alpha=0.7)
    ax.set_title('Actual vs Predicted (Full Dataset)')
    ax.set_xlabel('Time (sequential)')
    ax.set_ylabel('Price')
    ax.legend()

    # 2. Test set time series
    ax = axes[0, 1]
    time_test = np.arange(len(actual_test))
    ax.plot(time_test, actual_test, label='Actual', alpha=0.7)
    ax.plot(time_test, preds['test'], label='Predicted', alpha=0.7)
    ax.set_title('Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)')
    ax.set_xlabel('Time (test order)')
    ax.set_ylabel('Price')
    ax.legend()

    # 3. Scatter plot (test)
    ax = axes[0, 2]
    ax.scatter(actual_test, preds['test'], alpha=0.5, s=10)
    min_val = min(actual_test.min(), preds['test'].min())
    max_val = max(actual_test.max(), preds['test'].max())
    ax.plot([min_val, max_val], [min_val, max_val], 'r--', label='Ideal')
    ax.set_xlabel('Actual Price')
    ax.set_ylabel('Predicted Price')
    ax.set_title('Test Set: Actual vs Predicted (Scatter)')
    ax.legend()
    ax.axis('equal')

    # 4. Residual plot (test)
    ax = axes[1, 0]
    residuals = actual_test - preds['test']
    ax.scatter(preds['test'], residuals, alpha=0.5, s=10)
    ax.axhline(y=0, color='r', linestyle='--')
    ax.set_xlabel('Predicted Price')
    ax.set_ylabel('Residual')
    ax.set_title('Residual Plot (Test)')

    # 5. Residual histogram
    ax = axes[1, 1]
    ax.hist(residuals, bins=30, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
    ax.axvline(x=0, color='r', linestyle='--')
    ax.set_xlabel('Residual')
    ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
    ax.set_title('Histogram of Residuals (Test)')

    # 6. Loss curve (if history exists)
    ax = axes[1, 2]
    if history is not None:
        if name == 'XGBoost':
            # XGBoost history: {'validation_0': {'rmse': [...]}}
            if 'validation_0' in history and 'rmse' in history['validation_0']:
                epochs = len(history['validation_0']['rmse'])
                ax.plot(range(epochs), history['validation_0']['rmse'], label='Validation RMSE')
                ax.set_xlabel('Boosting round')
                ax.set_ylabel('RMSE')
                ax.set_title('XGBoost Learning Curve')
                ax.legend()
            else:
                ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No history', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
        elif name == 'LightGBM':
            if 'valid_0' in history and 'rmse' in history['valid_0']:
                epochs = len(history['valid_0']['rmse'])
                ax.plot(range(epochs), history['valid_0']['rmse'], label='Validation RMSE')
                ax.set_xlabel('Boosting round')
                ax.set_ylabel('RMSE')
                ax.set_title('LightGBM Learning Curve')
                ax.legend()
            else:
                ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No history', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
        elif name == 'CatBoost':
            if 'learn' in history and 'RMSE' in history['learn']:
                epochs = len(history['learn']['RMSE'])
                ax.plot(range(epochs), history['learn']['RMSE'], label='Train RMSE')
                if 'validation' in history and 'RMSE' in history['validation']:
                    ax.plot(range(epochs), history['validation']['RMSE'], label='Validation RMSE')
                ax.set_xlabel('Iteration')
                ax.set_ylabel('RMSE')
                ax.set_title('CatBoost Learning Curve')
                ax.legend()
            else:
                ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No history', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
        elif name == 'LSTM':
            if hasattr(history, 'history'):
                ax.plot(history.history['loss'], label='Train Loss')
                if 'val_loss' in history.history:
                    ax.plot(history.history['val_loss'], label='Validation Loss')
                ax.set_xlabel('Epoch')
                ax.set_ylabel('MSE')
                ax.set_title('LSTM Loss Curve')
                ax.legend()
            else:
                ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No history', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
        else:
            ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'Loss curve not available', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
    else:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'Loss curve not available', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

best_lstm.save(os.path.join(model_dir, "lstm.h5"))

print(f"All tuned models saved to {model_dir}")
